notes: `τῇ` is the verse's only article and takes *unto the* under rule 21, headed on *the*.
`Θεσσαλονικέων`, `πατρί` and `κυρίῳ` are all anarthrous, so their supplied determiners are rule 51/7 helpers on the nouns and no article is emptied.
The three names and the two `καί` connectives are split token by token under rules 26 and 28.
